sources.quote: HD 205739 is a yellow-white hued star in the southern constellation of Piscis Austrinus, positioned near the western constellation boundary with Microscopium.

introduction.text: Gaia's parallax, brightness and spectrum give it 1.4 solar radii and 1.18 solar masses (FLAME) and 6,117 K at its surface (GSP-Phot).
